title: Zen Browser from the sofa
summary: Firefox's shortcuts and Zen's own: compact mode, workspaces and split view. New tab, back and tabs on the pad.
author: Loungepad

actions.name: New tab
actions.desc: Opens a new tab, ready for an address or a search.

actions.name: Close tab
actions.desc: Closes the tab you are on.

actions.name: Back
actions.desc: Goes back to the page before this one.

actions.name: Forward
actions.desc: Goes forward again, after going back.

actions.name: Reload
actions.desc: Loads the page again, to see anything new on it.

actions.name: Address bar
actions.desc: Selects the address bar, to type an address or a search.

actions.name: Find in page
actions.desc: Looks for a word or phrase on this page.

actions.name: Full screen
actions.desc: Fills the whole screen with the page. Press it again to go back.

actions.name: Next tab
actions.desc: Switches to the next tab in the sidebar.

actions.name: Previous tab
actions.desc: Switches to the tab before it in the sidebar.

actions.name: Reopen closed tab
actions.desc: Brings back the tab you closed last.

actions.name: Next workspace
actions.desc: Moves to the next workspace, with its own tabs.

actions.name: Previous workspace
actions.desc: Moves to the workspace before this one.

actions.name: Copy page address
actions.desc: Copies the address of the page you are on, ready to paste.

actions.name: New window
actions.desc: Opens another Zen window.

actions.name: Private window
actions.desc: Opens a private window, which forgets its history and sign-ins once closed.

actions.name: Compact mode
actions.desc: Hides the toolbars and the sidebar, for more of the page. Again to bring them back.

actions.name: Sidebar width
actions.desc: Switches the tab sidebar between wide and narrow.

actions.name: Split side by side
actions.desc: Shows the selected tabs side by side. Select two or more in the sidebar first.

actions.name: Split top and bottom
actions.desc: Shows the selected tabs one above the other. Select them in the sidebar first.

actions.name: Unsplit
actions.desc: Puts tabs shown together back into tabs of their own.

actions.name: Zoom in
actions.desc: Makes the page bigger, text and pictures alike.

actions.name: Zoom out
actions.desc: Makes the page smaller, to fit more on the screen.

actions.name: Reset zoom
actions.desc: Puts the page back to its normal size.

actions.name: Mute tab
actions.desc: Mutes this tab's sound, or brings it back.

actions.name: Picture in picture
actions.desc: Pops the video on this page out into a small window that stays on top.

actions.name: Reader view
actions.desc: Shows the article on this page as plain, easy-to-read text.

actions.name: Bookmark this page
actions.desc: Saves the page as a bookmark, to find it again later.

actions.name: History
actions.desc: Shows the pages you have visited, in the sidebar.

actions.name: Downloads
actions.desc: Shows the files you have downloaded.

actions.name: Screenshot
actions.desc: Takes a picture of the page, or a part of it you choose.

actions.name: Print
actions.desc: Prints the page, or saves it as a PDF.
